FX-MIXER-001.says: The settings as they start, red 100, 0, 0, 0, green 0, 100, 0, 0, blue 0, 0, 100, 0, monochrome off: the drawing, untouched.

FX-MIXER-002.says: Red 0, 0, 100, 0 and blue 100, 0, 0, 0, red and blue swapped: the red turns blue, #2828c8, the blue turns orange, #ff6040, the green #50b43c and the skin a pale blue, #bed6f6; the white, the grey and the black stay as they are, as does every grey.

FX-MIXER-003.says: Red 0, 0, 0, 0: every pixel loses its red: the red turns #002828, the skin #00d6be and the white cyan, #00ffff; the black stays black.

FX-MIXER-004.says: Red 200, 0, 0, 0: every red doubled and held at the top: the line's red goes from #1e to #3c, the blue's from #40 to #80, and the grey, the red and the skin reach full red; the white and the black stay as they are.

FX-MIXER-005.says: Green 0, 100, 0, 50, a constant: every shown pixel's green is raised half the scale, held at the top: the black turns #008000 but for rounding (127.5), the grey's green is full, and the white stays white.

FX-MIXER-006.says: Each row taking its own channel away from a constant of 100, the negative: the white turns black and the black white, the grey #7f7f7f, the red cyan, #37d7d7, and the line a pale #e1e5db.

FX-MIXER-007.says: Monochrome on, the rows as they start: every channel takes the red row, so every pixel turns the grey of its own red: the red #c8c8c8, the green #3c3c3c, the blue #404040, the skin #f6f6f6; the white, the grey and the black stay as they are.

FX-MIXER-008.says: Monochrome on, red 30, 59, 11, 0: every pixel turns grey by those weights, the red #585858 (88), the green 133 and the skin 220.96 of 255; the weights add up to 100, so the white, the grey and the black stay as they are.

FX-MIXER-009.says: FX-MIXER-008 with green 0, 0, 0, 0 and blue 200, -200, 0, 50: with monochrome on the green and blue rows are not used, so the same.

FX-MIXER-010.says: Green 100, 0, 0, 0, green from red: every pixel's green becomes its red: the red turns yellow, #c8c828, the green #3c3c50, the blue #4040ff and the skin #f6f6be; every grey stays as it is.

FX-MIXER-011.says: Red 200, -200, 0, 0, the ends of the range: the red is twice the red less the green, held inside the scale: the red swatch keeps a full red, #ff2828, the green and the blue lose all their red, the skin's red is 64 (#40d6be) and every grey loses its red: the white turns cyan, #00ffff.

FX-MIXER-012.says: Red keyed from 100, 0, 0, 0 at frame 0 to 0, 0, 100, 0 at frame 4 and blue from 0, 0, 100, 0 to 100, 0, 0, 0, linear, one key holding all four numbers: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 red and blue both 50, 0, 50, 0, so the red swatch turns purple, #782878, and every grey stays as it is; frame 4 is FX-MIXER-002.

FX-MIXER-013.says: Green eased from 0, 100, 0, 0 at frame 0 to 0, 100, 0, 200 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: frame 0 untouched; at frame 2 the constant has gone past 200 (265) and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 alike give every shown pixel a full green.

FX-MIXER-014.says: Red keyed from 50, 0, 0, 0 at frame 0 to 150, 0, 0, 0 at frame 4: frame 0 halves every red, frame 2, the rows as they start, is the drawing untouched, and frame 4 raises every red by half, held at the top.

FX-MIXER-015.says: Monochrome on, red keyed from 100, 0, 0, 0 at frame 0 to 30, 59, 11, 0 at frame 4: frame 0 is FX-MIXER-007, frame 4 FX-MIXER-008, and frame 2 lies half way, the weights 65, 29.5, 5.5, 0.

FX-MIXER-016.says: FX-MIXER-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-MIXER-017.says: Red 201, 0, 0, 0: a number above 200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MIXER-018.says: Green 0, -250, 0, 0: a number below -200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MIXER-019.says: Green 0, 100, 0, -201: a constant below -200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MIXER-020.says: Blue written with three numbers, 0, 0, 100: a row is four. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MIXER-021.says: Red keyed to 0, 0, 300, 0 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MIXER-022.says: Monochrome "yes", not "off" or "on". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
